content.short: Coinmerce Capital offers managed crypto investment products, curating vaults on Hyperliquid.
content.description: Coinmerce Capital is the managed investment arm of Dutch exchange Coinmerce, offering discretionary crypto portfolios to clients who would rather not trade themselves. Portfolios are constructed and rebalanced by the firm, with exposure spread across major digital assets. Its activity extends to Hyperliquid.
content.meta: Managed crypto investment products from a European broker, extended into Hyperliquid vault curation.
